records.name: WheelSubsystem_ModuleInit
records.evidence: Direct XREF to literal LGDEV.IRX; direct call to wrapper init.

records.name: WheelRuntime_ConstantSourceSetter
records.evidence: Direct writer for source floats 0x00349528/0x0034952C. Verified direct calls at 0x00132AF4 and 0x00132DB4 both pass 0.0/0.0; no verified non-zero retail caller is currently recovered.

records.name: WheelRuntime_DriveFactorStage1
records.evidence: Retail SLPM dataflow reads the car value corresponding to field_1C4, divides by 2.5 and clamps to 1 before the later /0.35 FFB normalization.

records.name: WheelRuntime_PeriodicSurfaceSourceConsume
records.evidence: Retail SLPM loads the surface envelope from 0x0035F280, clears the consumed value, multiplies it by min(field_1C4,1), and passes it to the Type-4 source setter.

records.name: WheelRuntime_ConstantForceBuild
records.evidence: Retail SLPM sums source floats 0x00349528/0x0034952C, selects direction 90/270, and scales/caps magnitude at 220/255. The direct source setter's verified callers currently write only 0/0, so event semantics and any non-zero indirect caller remain unresolved.

records.name: WheelRuntime_SpringConditionUpdate
records.evidence: Retail Type-7 update uses symmetric coefficient 200 and saturation 15 + round(45*driveFactor), with zero offset/deadband.

records.name: WheelRuntime_DamperConditionUpdate
records.evidence: Retail Type-8 update uses symmetric coefficient round(10*(1-driveFactor)); builder confirms saturation 255 and zero offset/deadband.

records.name: WheelRuntime_WheelLevelScale
records.evidence: Retail SLPM reads wheel-mode game-state byte +0xFC, rejects values >=11, and derives the Type-4 multiplier (level+1)/11 before the periodic magnitude multiply at 0x00133340.

records.name: WheelRuntime_PeriodicBuild
records.evidence: Retail Type-4 build multiplies the periodic source by driveFactor, static magnitude scale 50 (0x0034950C), and the wheel-specific 0..10 setting multiplier (level+1)/11 before rounding; direction 90, phase 0, offset 0, and raw period 100 + round(60*driveFactor) are verified. Host period-unit interpretation remains provisional.

records.name: WheelRuntime_PeriodicStartThreshold
records.evidence: Retail Type-4 path suppresses/stops the effect when the rounded raw magnitude is below 0x1B (27).

records.name: EZWheelWrapper_Init
records.evidence: Literal EZ Wheel Wrapper v4.01 is referenced by this function.

records.name: WheelManager_StopCategory
records.evidence: Retail 0..11 category dispatcher stops/releases the category-specific effect object; paired with presence/query dispatcher 0x00133B20.

records.name: WheelManager_HasCategory
records.evidence: Retail 0..11 category presence dispatcher. Confirmed FFB ownership: category 1 ConstantForce, 2 Type-8 Damper condition, 7 Type-7 Spring condition, 8 periodic.

records.name: WheelManager_SpringType7
records.evidence: Retail builder queries manager category 7 and creates/updates a Type-7 condition; the initial caller supplies 70/70 and runtime caller supplies recovered Spring parameters.

records.name: WheelManager_ConstantForce
records.evidence: Retail builder queries manager category 1 and converges on verified ConstantForce download/update wrappers.

records.name: WheelManager_DamperType8
records.evidence: Retail builder queries manager category 2 and updates the condition wrapper with effect type 8 and recovered Damper coefficient/saturation.

records.name: WheelManager_Periodic
records.evidence: Retail builder queries manager category 8; the main wheel update supplies effect type 4 and recovered magnitude/period values.

records.name: WheelSurface_RoughnessLUT
records.evidence: Retail SLPM surface-mask/collision-context LUT; values and stage-specific 0x2/0x400000 cases match the reconstructed C2C/Xbox sub_1149C0 map.

records.name: WheelSurface_WheelFeedbackLevel
records.evidence: Wheel-device surface-feedback producer reads game-state +0xFC, validates 0..10, skips production at level 0, and for nonzero level derives base strength 0.20 + 0.08*level.

records.name: WheelRuntime_PeriodicSurfaceEnvelopeStore
records.evidence: After evaluating car offsets 0x24C/0x250/0x254/0x258 and retaining the maximum LUT value, retail SLPM stores the surface envelope to 0x0035F280. Later verified writes at 0x001D81BC/0x001D8268 can replace it with roughness*1.25 under recovered car-field predicates.

records.name: WheelRuntime_SurfaceEnvelopeBoostA
records.evidence: For roughness >0.30 and car float +0x268 <0.10, retail SLPM overwrites Type-4 surface source 0x0035F280 with roughness*1.25.

records.name: WheelRuntime_SurfaceEnvelopeBoostB
records.evidence: When the first boost predicate is false, roughness >0.30 and car float +0x264 >-0.10 cause retail SLPM to overwrite Type-4 source 0x0035F280 with roughness*1.25.

records.name: WheelOptions_FeedbackLevelControl
records.evidence: Retail options code constructs the relevant integer control with minimum 0 and maximum 10.

records.name: WheelOptions_StoreWheelFeedbackLevel
records.evidence: When the wheel-device path is active, the selected 0..10 options value is stored to game-state byte +0xFC.
